PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF DECLARATION OF DILIGENCE ATTACHED: FEE FOR SERVICE $40.00 SERVED APR-17-2017, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT VALLEJO STREET COMPANY, INC.

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAY-11-2017 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF MAY-11-2017 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF MICHAEL PAUL ABBATE IS PRESENT. DEFENDA VALLEJO STREET COMPANY, INC IS PRESENT. REPRESENTED BY DANIEL FONG, MANAGER. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-11-2017 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ABBATE, MICHAEL PAUL RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT VALLEJO STREET COMPANY, INC. $6,750.00 PRINCIPAL, $115.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $6,865.00, DEFENDANT SHALL RECEIVE A CREDIT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT IN THE AMOUNT OF $2,000.00 AN AMOUNT WHICH HAS ALREADY PAID BY THE DEFENDANT TO PLAINTIFF. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT VALLEJO STREET COMPANY, INC.
